# How to cancel ultimate voice line with a one tick freeze/stun

Source: [8176](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/8176); edited 2026-02-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-8176-n1"></a>

- Tutorial experiments with freezing a hero one tick after ultimate input to cancel voice lines while retaining ultimate behavior.

<a id="wiki-8176-n2"></a>

- It claims useful results for Winston/Bastion/Widowmaker/Reaper/Genji/Symmetra/Tracer/Baptiste, and conditional/tricky results for Sigma/Cassidy/Pharah; point-and-click ultimates may require rapid follow-up input.
